title: Bridge permissions policy (permissions.yaml, parsed)
description: `$HERMES_HOME/herald-os/permissions.yaml` once parsed. The reader is tolerant (an unknown key or a bad value falls back to the default and never widens access); this contract is strict, so a typo is caught by a validator instead of silently ignored. `destructive: allow` is accepted by the file but the code never honours it: the effective mode is `confirm` (behaviour, not shape).
